title: Real-to-Sim Calibration of Bosch Etching Simulators with Few-Shot XSEM Data and Hybrid Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.31904v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Bosch process is widely used in MEMS and TSV fabrication, but accurate prediction of etching outcomes remains difficult without calibration against real measurements, which are sparse and costly to obtain. This work presents a few-shot real-to-sim calibration framework that decouples simulator parameters from direct process variables to infer a recipe-specific simulator parameter vector from sparse measurements, enabling reliable prediction of etch depth and sidewall angle under held-out process conditions. We first formulate Bosch profile prediction as a few-shot real-to-sim calibration problem, where a small set of real XSEM measurements is used to identify a recipe-specific ViennaPS parameter vector $z_r^*$ that minimizes the discrepancy between simulated and measured etch depth and sidewall angle. To search this parameter space efficiently, the framework combines local exploration, LLM-guided candidate generation, and XGBoost-b

translated_title: 基于少样本XSEM数据与混合搜索的Bosch刻蚀模拟器真实到仿真校准
translated_abstract: Bosch工艺广泛应用于MEMS和TSV制造中，但在缺乏真实测量数据校准的情况下，准确预测刻蚀结果仍然困难，而真实测量数据稀疏且获取成本高昂。本工作提出了一个少样本真实到仿真校准框架，该框架将模拟器参数与直接工艺变量解耦，从稀疏测量数据中推断出特定配方的模拟器参数向量，从而在未见的工艺条件下实现刻蚀深度和侧壁角度的可靠预测。我们首先将Bosch轮廓预测表述为一个少样本真实到仿真校准问题，利用少量真实XSEM测量数据来识别特定配方的ViennaPS参数向量 $z_r^*$，以最小化模拟与测量的刻蚀深度和侧壁角度之间的差异。为了高效搜索该参数空间，该框架结合了局部探索、LLM引导的候选生成以及XGBoost基（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种少样本真实到仿真校准框架，通过将模拟器参数与工艺变量解耦，并结合局部探索、LLM引导候选生成和XGBoost的混合搜索策略，从稀疏XSEM测量中推断特定配方的Bosch刻蚀模拟器参数，实现对刻蚀深度和侧壁角度的可靠预测。
en_tdlr: A few-shot real-to-sim calibration framework that decouples simulator parameters from process variables and uses hybrid search (local exploration, LLM-guided candidate generation, and XGBoost) to infer recipe-specific Bosch etching simulator parameters from sparse XSEM data, enabling reliable prediction of etch depth and sidewall angle.
